## Prerequisites

- `tickets` feature shipped (bootstrap): `TicketService.GetAgentDashboardAsync`, `TicketComment.IsInternal`, `Api/Controllers/TicketsController.cs` route `GET /api/dashboard/agent`, watchers on tickets.
- Coordinate the shared **`INotificationService`** contract with the `sla-automation` feature owner. `backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/Sla/NotificationService.cs` already exists and must be the canonical implementation reused here — do not fork it.
- Frontend dashboard base already renders: `frontend/src/views/dashboard/AgentDashboardView.vue`.

## Story Goal

Turn `AgentDashboardView.vue` into an actual workspace by adding four capabilities and stitching them into the dashboard:

1. **Tasks & Reminders** — CRUD entity per user, optional link to a ticket or customer, due date + done flag, in-app notification when a reminder fires; overdue and due-today lists render on the dashboard.
2. **Quick replies** — canned bilingual (`BodyAr`/`BodyEn`) templates scoped by department, with placeholders (`{{customer.name}}`, `{{ticket.number}}`, etc.) resolved server-side, insertable from the ticket reply composer.
3. **@-mentions in internal notes** — parse `@username` in `TicketComment` where `IsInternal = true`; raise a notification and expose a **“Mentioning me”** filter on the tickets list.
4. **Notification centre** — unread list, mark-read, deep-link to source ticket, backed by the existing `Notification` entity (`backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Entities/Notification.cs`).
5. **Team dashboard view** — Admin/Manager only, per-agent open / overdue / resolved-today counts within their department + branch scope.

Out of scope (defer to sibling features): email/SMS transport (`channels`), AI-generated replies (`ai-features`), historical reports (`reports`).

Cross-cutting: all lists respect **department + branch scope** via `IScopeProvider`; every panel loads independently through `Promise.allSettled`; new tables are soft-deletable + audited.

### 7 — Reminder dispatcher (BackgroundService)

**File: `backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Api/Services/ReminderDispatcherHostedService.cs`** — mirror `SlaEvaluatorHostedService.cs`.

- Polls every 60 seconds using `IClock`.
- Uses a **claim query** to be multi-instance-safe:

  ```csharp
  var now = _clock.UtcNow;
  var due = await db.AgentTasks
      .Where(t => t.IsReminder && !t.IsDone
                  && t.DueAt <= now
                  && t.ReminderDispatchedAt == null)
      .OrderBy(t => t.DueAt)
      .Take(100)
      .ToListAsync(ct);

  foreach (var t in due)
  {
      t.ReminderDispatchedAt = now;
      // save first to claim, then notify
  }
  await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

  foreach (var t in due)
      await notifications.NotifyAsync(t.OwnerUserId, ...);
  ```

  If the process dies between save and notify, an admin-only re-dispatch endpoint may be added later — out of scope here, but leave a `TODO` comment.

- Register in `Api/Program.cs` next to `SlaEvaluatorHostedService`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Reminder fires while task marked done milliseconds earlier.** Dispatcher re-checks `IsDone == false` inside the claim loop; enforced in `ReminderDispatcherHostedService`.
- **Two API instances poll the same reminder.** `ReminderDispatchedAt` is claimed by the first `SaveChangesAsync` (row-level lock via update); second instance's update affects zero rows and skips. Test with a duplicate call in unit test.
- **Task references a ticket in another department.** `AgentTaskService.CreateAsync` calls `IScopeProvider` before insert; returns `NotFoundException` (never leak existence via `Forbidden`).
- **Quick reply placeholder references a null customer or ticket.** `QuickReplyPlaceholderResolver` emits the literal placeholder + collects a warning; UI shows warnings under the composer. Enforced in `QuickReplyPlaceholderResolver.Resolve`.
- **`@username` matches multiple users** (identical login-lookup). Backend inserts a mention for each match, but notifies only exact user id matches; ambiguous handles surface as no-op with a debug log.
- **Mention in a customer-visible reply.** Only comments with `IsInternal == true` trigger mentions/notifications; internal-note code path enforces this in `TicketService.Operations.cs`.
- **Notification centre listing after the source ticket was soft-deleted.** List query left-joins the source and filters out items whose entity is soft-deleted; degrade to “item unavailable” in the UI rather than 404.
- **Team dashboard for a manager who has no department set.** Return an empty `Rows` array + a warning key `dashboard.team.noDepartment` for the UI to render, not an exception.
- **Dashboard panel returns 500.** `Promise.allSettled` in `AgentDashboardView.vue` renders a per-panel error; the page remains interactive. Confirm existing pattern in the same view is followed.
- **Unicode / RTL in task titles.** Titles stored as `nvarchar(256)`; UI wraps mixed-script content correctly via logical properties. Test with an Arabic title + English ticket number.
- **Timezone drift on `DueAt`.** Persist as `DateTimeOffset`; dispatcher compares against `_clock.UtcNow`. `useFormat.ts` renders in the user's locale.
- **Placeholder recursion or template injection.** Resolver does a single pass over the template; disallows nested `{{...{{...}}...}}` by treating placeholder tokens as opaque regex matches.

## Migration / Rollback

- Migration name: `AgentDashboard`. Introduces `AgentTasks`, `QuickReplies`, `TicketMentions`.
- **Forward:** `dotnet ef database update`. Idempotent because it only adds tables.
- **Rollback:** `dotnet ef database update <previous_migration_name>` (the SLA migration `20260928174834_SlaAutomation`) drops the new tables. No existing table is altered, so no data loss on rollback.
- Half-applied risk: if migration lands but the new hosted service is not deployed, reminders queue silently — safe. If code deploys before migration, `AgentTaskService` errors on first call; keep migration + code in one release.
- No seeding of quick replies in `DbSeeder.cs` (leave to operators). Optionally seed one Arabic + one English demo template guarded by `IsDevelopment`.
